entities.name: Dieudonné Datonou
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dieudonné Datonou is a Beninese archbishop of the Catholic Church who has worked in the diplomatic service of the Holy See since 1995. On 7 October 2021, he was appointed Apostolic Nuncio to Burundi and elevated to the rank of archbishop.
